pages.text: $(bold)Mana Shield$() (default trait of all four $(bold)Wizard Set$() pieces, $(bold)unleveled$())$(br2)Active as long as you wear $(bold)any single piece$() carrying this trait.$(br2)$(bold)Three effects$():$(li)$(bold)-10% non-physical damage per piece$() ($(bold)chained$(): about -19% with two pieces, -34.4% with four)$(li)$(bold)+2 max health per piece$() (stacks, +8 for the full set)$(li)$(bold)All buffs and debuffs on you last half as long$() ($(bold)does not stack$() - always x0.5 no matter how many pieces; infinite effects are unaffected)

$(bold)Three kinds the shield never reduces$():$(li)$(bold)physical$() - melee / contact, entity projectiles (arrows, tridents, thrown items), kinetic (fall, falling blocks), explosions$(li)$(bold)void$() - falling out of the world, plus modded void types (Goety $(bold)voided$(), gun mod $(bold)bullet_void$(), L2 Complements $(bold)void_eye$() ...)$(li)$(bold)piercing$() - this mod's $(bold)true_pierce$() (the true damage used by Pierce EX, sword aura, Laevatain and friends)$(br2)Rule-level damage such as $(bold)/kill$() and out-of-world is never reduced either.

Everything else (fire, lava, lightning, magic, Iron's Spells and Goety spells, wither, freezing, drowning, sonic boom ...) is $(bold)-10% per piece$().$(br2)$(italic)Two datapack tags define this and can be edited:$(li)$(bold)tinkersnewlife:is_physical$() - what counts as physical$(li)$(bold)tinkersnewlife:ignores_mana_shield$() - void / piercing / rule-level$(br2)The trait also reads Goety's own $(bold)goety:physical$() tag, falls back to "direct source is a living entity and not magic" for modded melee, and to "id contains void" for modded void damage.$()
